The '''House of Metara''' was a noble family from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. Its seat was situated in [[Crevasse City (Alderaan)/Legends|Crevasse City]].

==History==
For generations, many members of the House of Metara served in their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld's]] government as councilors and [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassadors]]. The Metaras who did not choose to enter public service became [[Artist/Legends|artists]], [[Doctor/Legends|physicians]], researchers, or [[Teacher/Legends|teachers]].

[[Stavin Metara]] worked as an artist, while his wife, [[Gerane Metara]], served as an administrator in [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan's]] education council. Their daughter, [[Caline Metara]], became a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] after the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction of Alderaan]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].
